rationale: M37.21 #610 kotlin KD19: enums are first-class heritage participants. enum class Direction(...) : Mode emits implements Direction->Mode (bare supertype); enum class Counted : Numbered(1) emits extends Counted->Numbered (constructor-invocation supertype). Pre-fix extractEnumClass never extracted superTypes so every enum-with-supertype silently dropped its heritage (Exposed ForUpdateOption.kt MODE -> ForUpdateOrShareMode was the measured corpus hit).
